description: OpenSCAD text-to-CAD benchmark. Prompts adapted from earthtojake/text-to-cad (MIT) and rewritten for OpenSCAD's mm/CSG conventions. Scoring is two-layer: (1) does the produced .scad parse and render to non-empty geometry, and (2) do measurable facts (bounding box, dimension) match the spec within tolerance. Bounding boxes are axis-aligned sizes in mm.

benchmarks.prompt: Create a rectangular block 100 mm long in X, 60 mm wide in Y, and 20 mm tall in Z, centered on the XY origin with its bottom face at Z=0. Add four vertical 8 mm diameter through-holes at X=+/-35 mm and Y=+/-20 mm. Add a 2 mm chamfer on the top outer perimeter edges only (do not chamfer the holes).

expected.notes: Four through-holes; one solid; chamfer on top perimeter only.

benchmarks.prompt: Create an 80 mm diameter, 10 mm thick circular flange with a 30 mm central through-bore. Add six 6 mm through-holes on a 60 mm diameter bolt circle. Round the outer circular edges with a small fillet.

expected.notes: Central 30 mm bore; six 6 mm holes on a 60 mm bolt circle.

benchmarks.prompt: Create an L-bracket from a 80 x 60 x 6 mm base plate lying in XY and a 80 x 40 x 6 mm rear vertical plate rising in +Z along the back edge. Add two 5 mm vertical holes in the base and two 5 mm horizontal holes in the back plate, and two triangular gussets connecting the plates.

expected.notes: Base + back plate + two gussets; holes in two directions.

benchmarks.prompt: Create a hollow open-top rectangular enclosure with outer footprint 120 x 80 mm and total height 35 mm, with 3 mm walls and a 3 mm floor. Add four internal corner standoffs with centered 2.5 mm blind holes, and round the four outside vertical corners with a 2 mm radius.

expected.notes: Hollow shell (open top), four internal standoffs, rounded vertical corners.

benchmarks.prompt: Create a 120 mm long shaft along X made of three coaxial stepped cylinders: 20 mm diameter for 40 mm, then 30 mm diameter for 40 mm, then 20 mm diameter for 40 mm. Add small chamfers on both ends and a shallow rectangular keyway on top of the middle 30 mm section.

expected.notes: Three stepped diameters along X; keyway on the middle section.
